english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unrealized ability or capacity, especially someone’s ability to develop or achieve something.

examples.english: This project still has great potential to develop into an international brand.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃仲有好大潛力，可以發展成國際品牌。
